decisions.question: Which starter should the docs plugin ship?

options.label: Neutral starter + size choice
options.summary: Written fresh; init --starter minimal|app (options C + D).

options.label: Neutral starter only
options.summary: One fuller starter replaces the minimal template (C).

options.label: C+E now
options.summary: One neutral starter, plus the skill reads the project's styles and fills token values after asking.

options.label: Keep minimal
options.summary: No change (A).

decisions.question: May DOCSPEC R15.6 be reworded to allow a starter set of generic rules?

options.label: Yes, reword
options.summary: Templates hold structure and a starter set of generic, project-neutral rules, never one project's rules.

options.label: No, keep R15.6
options.summary: The starter stays within a few example rules.

decisions.question: How big should the starter be?

options.label: About 12-15 of each
options.summary: Generic rules and components.

options.label: About 6-8 of each
options.summary: A smaller core.

options.label: As close to v4 as neutral allows
options.summary: About 20 or more components and the full rule set, domain parts removed.

decisions.chosen: As close to v4 as neutral allows
decisions.owner_words: option 3 and provide me a report of what did not make from v4 into the default design-system, why, and options to bring it into the default template

decisions.question: Which themes should the starter ship?

options.label: Light + dark
options.summary: Switched by prefers-color-scheme and data-theme.

options.label: Light only
options.summary: Dark added later.

options.label: Light, dark + theme slots
options.summary: Plus a documented way to add named themes.

decisions.question: Which fonts should the starter use?

options.label: System font stacks
options.summary: Nothing bundled.

options.label: One bundled open font
options.summary: One OFL font with its licence.

decisions.question: What should the skill do with the project's existing styles?

options.label: Show, ask, then fill
options.summary: List what it found, ask once, fill token values on yes.

options.label: Fill automatically
options.summary: Fill, then report.

decisions.question: Where does the report of what was left out go?

options.label: Section on the feature page
options.summary: A Left out section on this page.

options.label: docs/architecture report
options.summary: A Markdown report.

decisions.question: Should the gallery draw real visuals?

options.label: Swatches, samples and rendered components
options.summary: Colour swatches with WCAG marks, type/spacing/radius samples and components drawn from the tokens.

options.label: Swatches and samples only
options.summary: No drawn components.

options.label: Keep text only
options.summary: No change.

decisions.owner_words: Colour swatches + contrast; Type, spacing, radius samples; Rendered components (multi-select)

decisions.question: Which components does the gallery draw?

options.label: Core set
options.summary: Button, input, check box row, card, table, badge, focus ring.

options.label: Every starter component
options.summary: All starter component sections get a drawn sample.

decisions.question: What happens when a token a sample needs is missing or not a plain value?

options.label: Draw with a marked fallback
options.summary: Neutral fallback, a 'token missing' label, gaps listed at the top.

options.label: Skip that sample
options.summary: Listed as not drawn.

options.label: Fail the build
options.summary: visuals exits with an error.

decisions.question: Which bar do the contrast marks use?

options.label: WCAG 2.2 AA
options.summary: 4.5:1 text, 3:1 large text and UI parts.

decisions.question: Does a gallery built by an older script count as stale?

options.label: Yes, stale
options.summary: The gallery stamps the script version; DS4 warns until next-version is rebuilt; numbered versions are never rebuilt.

options.label: No
options.summary: Rebuilt only on the next design change.

decisions.question: Do samples show light and dark?

options.label: Both, side by side
options.summary: Light and dark when tokens.md has dark values; light only otherwise, with a note.

options.label: Follow the viewer's setting
options.summary: One theme at a time.
